chain: The tree follows the paper's route end to end. It builds the bit network, frames, labels and rank budget, then the shear-to-interchange recurrence and arbitrary-width interchange (S1). It continues with the complex phase network, packed basis changes and the layer recurrence (S2), then synthetic transforms and ring convolution (S3), resampling with chirp and permutation cancellation (S4), and assembly with exact recovery (S5), ending at the margin table that gives O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}) (S6). The thin spots are not the main saving. They are the gate-label and residual tables behind the label lemma, the endpoint C^{⊗m} computation and the complex-side exponent eta_c, the guard-depth recurrence for the layer, and the intermediate ring, chirp and twist error bounds before E_s.

steps.note: h=100, banks X_a,Y_a indexed by triples of three-element subsets, m=h^3 (S1.1.3), and the fixed network (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) restoring every scratch wire. N is not written as binom(h,3)^3, though it is implied by the indexing and used as the number of X_a roles.
Common frame per gate commuting with the pointwise gate, the operator D_out S D_in^{-1}, and the motivation that each edge then costs only a change of frame.

Nondegenerate subspace labels in (Q^h)^{⊗3} of dimension m, comparable labels on every edge, and the only decreasing edges being central 3->4, each losing h. The gate-label table itself is not reproduced.
P_V-P_U is the projection onto V∩U^perp of rank dim V - dim U; the N source edges 2P_{U_a} have rank one where the dimension change is zero.
L=Ich, the absolute changes summing to Wm-2N+2L by telescoping at gates, and s_b=(W_bm-2N+2L_b)+N=W_bm-N+2L_b.
L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2, so the deficits N-2L_b>0 and 2N-2L_c>0 give s<Wm.
Endpoint difference P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m on X_a, zero to identity on the other roles, so Phi_{I_m}: H<-H+D on every row, scratch rows included.
A=E_1 Pi E_2, the triangular factors at O(V), one interchange per one of Pi, hence exactly a recursive calls per edge and s per node.
Children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), tau=1-2^{-50} from eta_b>20*2^{-50} and log m<20, and F_k=O(e^tau) by the geometric sum.

central.summary: The plan reconstructs all nine steps of the central saving in their roles. The fixed bank-exchange network, frames, nested labels, rank equal to dimension change with the N rank-one source exceptions, the budget W_bm-N+2L_b, the strict deficit from L/N<1/2, the endpoint identity giving H<-H+D, edges as rank-many recursive interchanges, and the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50} all appear with their defining quantities. The only softness is that N=binom(h,3)^3 is left implicit and the label table is summarized rather than shown.
